background_primary: top-5000 variance genes of the final 4b fit (the pool the model was selected from)

ora.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each gene list x collection x background

population: GSE181063 training set, primary population (sex_mismatch_confident excluded); survival data never read

rank_test.highlight_rule: robust = BH FDR < 0.05 in BOTH the permutation and the gene-sampling test
rank_test.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within collection, separately for each test
rank_test.null: patient-label permutation of LP (preserves gene-gene correlation)
rank_test.second_test: PAGE-type gene-sampling z (Kim & Volsky 2005), normal approximation with finite-population correction
rank_test.statistic: mean Spearman rho(gene, LP) in set minus mean over universe
rank_test.universe: primary background minus the 44 model genes (removes circularity)

score: frozen 44-gene linear predictor (model_04.json) on training expression, apparent (in-sample)

signatures.association: Spearman rho with LP, 1000 patient bootstraps (percentile CI)
signatures.lymph2cx: Scott et al. Blood 2014; COO score = mean z(ABC genes) - mean z(GCB genes)
signatures.model_gene_overlap: rho also reported with the 44 model genes removed from each signature
signatures.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within curated panel and within the C2-CGP group separately

proxies.HALLMARK_ANGIOGENESIS: vascular / stromal-2 proxy (not the Lenz 2008 gene list)
proxies.HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITI: ECM / stromal-1 proxy (not the Lenz 2008 gene list)

signatures.regression: OLS of LP on standardized signature scores (model genes removed), descriptive R^2 only
signatures.score: mean of per-gene z-scores (primary population, ddof 1) over genes found among the 13,747 common genes
